name: @apet97/clockify-mcp-115

tools.name: clockify_tools_guide
tools.description: Show the workflow-first tool groups and when to use domain tools instead.

tools.name: clockify_plan_change
tools.description: READ-ONLY planning: explain which Clockify tools a change will use, in order, before anything mutates. For each step it reports the tool, whether it mutates, and whether it needs the dry_run -> confirm_token handshake. Accepts a free-text `goal` (e.g. "invoice Acme", "log yesterday's work", "clean demo data") and an optional `entity`. Makes no API calls. Next: call the first tool in the returned plan.

tools.name: clockify_create_work_package
tools.description: Create or reuse a client, project, task, and tags from names or IDs.

tools.name: clockify_log_work
tools.description: Log a finished time entry from names or IDs; accepts start/end or duration_seconds plus end.

tools.name: clockify_start_work
tools.description: Start a running work timer using human-friendly names or returned IDs.

tools.name: clockify_stop_work
tools.description: Stop the current running work timer. Returns ok when no timer is running.

tools.name: clockify_switch_work
tools.description: Stop the current timer and start a new timer in one workflow call.

tools.name: clockify_review_day
tools.description: Review one day of entries for totals, running timers, and missing details.

date.description: Day to review, as YYYY-MM-DD or a relative word ("yesterday", "last monday"). Defaults to the UTC calendar day, which is not the account's day near local midnight outside UTC — pass it explicitly there. An impossible day (e.g. 2026-02-30) is rejected, not rolled forward.

tools.name: clockify_review_week
tools.description: Review a week of entries for totals, running timers, and missing details.

week_start.description: Day to review, as YYYY-MM-DD or a relative word ("yesterday", "last monday"). Defaults to the UTC calendar day, which is not the account's day near local midnight outside UTC — pass it explicitly there. An impossible day (e.g. 2026-02-30) is rejected, not rolled forward.

tools.name: clockify_fix_entry
tools.description: Find one entry by ID or strict filters, then update selected fields (description, start/end, project, task, tags, billable).

tools.name: clockify_invoice_client_work
tools.description: Create a draft invoice for a client name or ID. Supports dry_run plus confirm_token.

tools.name: clockify_record_expense
tools.description: Record an expense with category and project names or IDs. The amount is in MAJOR currency units (19.99 = $19.99), not cents. Supports dry_run plus confirm_token.

amount.description: Amount in MAJOR currency units (19.99 = $19.99). Expense amounts are NOT cents, unlike invoice and rate fields.

tools.name: clockify_request_time_off
tools.description: Create a time-off request with a policy name or ID. Supports dry_run plus confirm_token.

start.description: Start date. DAYS-unit policies want a date-only start (yyyy-MM-dd); HOURS-unit policies want a full RFC3339 datetime (yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ssZ).

end.description: Range end (RFC3339). Required by HOURS-unit (date-range) policies; omit for DAYS-unit policies and pass `days`. Provide `end` OR `days`.

days.description: Number of days. Required by DAYS-unit policies; omit for HOURS-unit policies and pass `end`. Provide `end` OR `days`.

half_day_period.description: Which half to take when half_day is true: FIRST_HALF (morning, default) or SECOND_HALF (afternoon).

tools.name: clockify_schedule_work
tools.description: Create a scheduling assignment by user and project names or IDs. Supports dry_run plus confirm_token.

tools.name: clockify_setup_webhook
tools.description: Create a webhook subscription after HTTPS URL validation. Supports dry_run plus confirm_token. Always scoped to the pinned workspace (triggerSourceType WORKSPACE_ID); use clockify_webhooks_create for a supported non-workspace trigger source such as USER_ID or PROJECT_ID.

tools.name: clockify_demo_seed
tools.description: Create or reuse deterministic demo client/project/task/tag/time-entry objects.

tools.name: clockify_demo_cleanup
tools.description: Delete deterministic demo objects by prefix, continuing through partial failures.

tools.name: clockify_docs_search
tools.description: Search compact Clockify SDK, CLI, and MCP guidance for agents. Read-only; returns ranked guidance chunks.

tools.name: clockify_operation_guide
tools.description: Map a user task, operation, or tool name to the recommended SDK, CLI, and MCP paths. Read-only.

tools.name: clockify_sdk_snippet
tools.description: Return a compact SDK, CLI, or MCP usage snippet for a common Clockify task. Read-only.

tools.name: clockify_status
tools.description: Return the pinned workspace ID, the current user, and any running timer for that user.

tools.name: clockify_doctor
tools.description: Run a live connection preflight: validate CLOCKIFY_API_KEY against /user, confirm the pinned CLOCKIFY_WORKSPACE_ID is reachable for that key, report base-URL posture, and estimate clock skew. Returns a pass/fail receipt with per-failure remediation.

tools.name: clockify_entity_changes_list
tools.description: Experimental API: choose the required created, updated, or deleted changeType to call one matching entity-change endpoint. Response shape and behavior may change. When start/end are omitted, Clockify applies its documented default 30-day/current date behavior.

tools.name: clockify_projects_list
tools.description: List projects in the pinned workspace, paginated via page and pageSize.

tools.name: clockify_projects_create
tools.description: Create a project in the pinned workspace.

tools.name: clockify_projects_get
tools.description: Fetch one project by ID from the pinned Clockify workspace.

tools.name: clockify_projects_memberships_list
tools.description: Inspect the membership-facing fields returned by one project read before changing project access.

tools.name: clockify_projects_memberships_update
tools.description: Replace project memberships with verified workspace users and optional verified user groups. Rate amounts are integer minor units. Run dry_run first, review the exact resolved request, then retry with the returned confirm_token.

userId.description: Workspace user ID, exact name, or `me`.

tools.name: clockify_projects_update
tools.description: Update project metadata such as name, client, visibility, color, or archive state.

tools.name: clockify_projects_delete
tools.description: Permanently delete one project by ID. Run dry_run first, then retry with the returned confirm_token.

tools.name: clockify_projects_set_member_rate
tools.description: Set a user's hourly (billable) or cost rate ON a specific project. Amount is in MAJOR units (e.g. 75 = $75.00); Clockify stores integer minor units. The member must already be on the project.

rateKind.description: HOURLY = billable rate; COST = internal cost rate.

amount.description: Rate in major units, e.g. 75 for $75/hr.

tools.name: clockify_projects_templates_list
tools.description: List the workspace's project templates — the same projects endpoint filtered to `is-template`. Use a template id with clockify_projects_create to seed a new project's structure.

tools.name: clockify_projects_templates_mark
tools.description: Turn an existing project into a reusable template, or turn that flag back off. This does not copy the project; it flags the project itself, so the project keeps its own time entries and members. Run dry_run first, then retry with the returned confirm_token.

projectId.description: Project id (24-hex) or exact project name.

isTemplate.description: true marks it a template; false clears the flag.

tools.name: clockify_projects_estimates_update
tools.description: Set a project's budget estimate (minor units) and/or time estimate (ISO-8601 duration, for example PT40H). Send only the estimate you want to change; each one you send REPLACES that estimate's current settings. Run dry_run first, then retry with the returned confirm_token.

projectId.description: Project id (24-hex) or exact project name.

timeEstimate.description: Time estimate as an ISO-8601 duration, for example PT40H.

active.description: Whether the estimates you send are enforced.

tools.name: clockify_clients_list
tools.description: List clients in the pinned workspace, paginated via page and pageSize.

tools.name: clockify_clients_create
tools.description: Create a client record in the pinned workspace with optional notes.

tools.name: clockify_clients_get
tools.description: Fetch one client by ID from the pinned Clockify workspace.

tools.name: clockify_clients_update
tools.description: Update client metadata such as name, note, address, or archived state.

tools.name: clockify_clients_delete
tools.description: Permanently delete one client by ID. Run dry_run first, then retry with the returned confirm_token.

tools.name: clockify_tags_list
tools.description: List tags in the pinned workspace, paginated via page and pageSize.

tools.name: clockify_tags_create
tools.description: Create a tag in the pinned workspace for later time-entry classification.

tools.name: clockify_tags_get
tools.description: Fetch one tag by ID from the pinned Clockify workspace.

tools.name: clockify_tags_update
tools.description: Update a tag's name or archived state in the pinned workspace.

tools.name: clockify_tags_delete
tools.description: Permanently delete one tag by ID. Run dry_run first, then retry with the returned confirm_token.

tools.name: clockify_tasks_list
tools.description: List tasks for a project in the pinned workspace, paginated via page and pageSize.

tools.name: clockify_tasks_create
tools.description: Create a task under one project with optional estimate and assignees.

tools.name: clockify_tasks_get
tools.description: Fetch one task by project ID and task ID from the pinned workspace.

tools.name: clockify_tasks_update
tools.description: Update task metadata such as name, status, estimate, billing, or assignees.

tools.name: clockify_tasks_delete
tools.description: Permanently delete one task by project ID and task ID. Run dry_run first, then retry with the returned confirm_token.

tools.name: clockify_tasks_set_rate
tools.description: Set a task's hourly (billable) or cost rate. Amount is in MAJOR units (e.g. 75 = $75.00); Clockify stores integer minor units.

rateKind.description: HOURLY = billable rate; COST = internal cost rate.

amount.description: Rate in major units, e.g. 75 for $75/hr.

tools.name: clockify_entries_list
tools.description: List the current user's time entries in the pinned workspace, paginated via page and pageSize.

tools.name: clockify_entries_log
tools.description: Create a finished time entry from an explicit start + end, or duration + end.

durationSeconds.description: If set with `end`, computes start = end - durationSeconds.

tools.name: clockify_entries_delete
tools.description: Permanently delete one time entry by ID. Run dry_run first, then retry with the returned confirm_token.

tools.name: clockify_entries_get
tools.description: Fetch one time entry by ID from the pinned Clockify workspace.

tools.name: clockify_entries_get_many
tools.description: Fetch several time entries by ID in one call. The endpoint silently omits IDs it cannot resolve, so the result can be shorter than timeEntryIds; compare `count` against the number of IDs you sent.

hydrated.description: Include project, task, and tag detail on each entry.

tools.name: clockify_entries_update
tools.description: Full REPLACE of a time entry (PUT semantics): every optional field you omit — end, description, projectId, taskId, tagIds, billable, and any custom-field values — is CLEARED on the entry. Supply every field you want to keep, or use clockify_fix_entry, which reads the entry first and preserves untouched fields. Run dry_run first, then retry with the returned confirm_token.

tools.name: clockify_entries_mark_invoiced
tools.description: Mark the given time entries as invoiced (or clear the flag with invoiced:false) in the pinned workspace.

tools.name: clockify_timer_start
tools.description: Start a running time entry for the current user. Description and IDs are optional.

tools.name: clockify_timer_stop
tools.description: Stop the running timer for the current user. Returns ok with a note if no timer was running.

tools.name: clockify_invoices_list
tools.description: List invoices in the pinned workspace, optionally filtered by one or more invoice statuses and sorted by a column/order.

sortColumn.description: Sort column: ID | CLIENT | DUE_ON | ISSUE_DATE | AMOUNT | BALANCE.

tools.name: clockify_invoices_get
tools.description: Fetch a single invoice by ID, including its line items.

tools.name: clockify_invoices_create
tools.description: Draft a new invoice. Dates accept YYYY-MM-DD (promoted to midnight UTC) or full RFC3339.

note.description: Not accepted on create; create the draft, then use invoices_update.

subject.description: Not accepted on create; create the draft, then use invoices_update.

tools.name: clockify_invoices_update
tools.description: Update invoice metadata. Reads the invoice then replaces it, preserving untouched fields and mapping tax/discount correctly. Status changes go through clockify_invoices_update_status.

taxPercent.description: Primary tax rate as a percent (e.g. 15 for 15%).

tax2Percent.description: Secondary tax rate as a percent.

tools.name: clockify_invoices_delete
tools.description: Permanently delete an invoice. Billing-impactful; coordinate before running. Run dry_run first, then retry with the returned confirm_token.

tools.name: clockify_invoices_update_status
tools.description: Move an invoice between statuses (UNSENT, SENT, PAID, PARTIALLY_PAID, VOID, OVERDUE).

tools.name: clockify_invoices_import_time
tools.description: Import time entries (and optionally expenses) into an existing invoice over a date range.

from.description: ISO start of the import window

to.description: ISO end of the import window

projectFilter.description: Project filter; status is required, e.g. { "status": "ACTIVE" }

tools.name: clockify_invoices_info
tools.description: Search invoice 'info' records (POST /invoices/info) by status / invoice-number filters, sorted and paginated. Complements clockify_invoices_list with the richer info projection.

invoiceNumber.description: Filter by a substring of the invoice number.

strictSearch.description: When true, invoiceNumber must match exactly.

sortColumn.description: Sort column: ID | CLIENT | DUE_ON | ISSUE_DATE | AMOUNT | BALANCE.

tools.name: clockify_invoices_items_list
tools.description: Return just the line items of an invoice — a focused projection of clockify_invoices_get for when only the items matter.

tools.name: clockify_invoices_items_add
tools.description: Append one line item to an existing invoice. Give `unitPrice` in the workspace currency's MINOR units (cents) — the tool scales it to the item wire value for you. Run dry_run first, then retry with the returned confirm_token.

itemType.description: Name of an EXISTING workspace invoice item type. Item types are created in the Clockify UI and there is no API route that lists them; the API rejects an unknown name with 404 "Invoice item type with name X not found". Read an existing invoice with clockify_invoices_items_list to see the names this workspace uses.

unitPrice.description: Unit price in minor units (cents), for example 100000 for 1,000.00.

tools.name: clockify_invoices_items_delete
tools.description: Permanently remove one line item from an invoice. The item is addressed by its `order` position, not by an id — read clockify_invoices_items_list first, because deleting one item renumbers the rest. Run dry_run first, then retry with the returned confirm_token.

tools.name: clockify_invoices_payments_list
tools.description: List recorded payments against an invoice, paginated.

tools.name: clockify_invoices_payments_create
tools.description: Record one payment against an invoice. `amount` is in MINOR units (cents). Payments are additive and the API does not deduplicate, so a repeated call records a second payment. The API answers with the updated invoice, so `data.paymentId` is recovered by diffing the payments list around the write and is null when the diff names no single new payment. Run dry_run first, then retry with the returned confirm_token.

paymentDate.description: RFC3339 timestamp; the API defaults to now when omitted.

tools.name: clockify_invoices_payments_delete
tools.description: Permanently remove one recorded payment from an invoice, which changes the invoice balance and may move its status. Run dry_run first, then retry with the returned confirm_token.

tools.name: clockify_expenses_list
tools.description: List workspace expenses with optional date range and pagination.

tools.name: clockify_expenses_get
tools.description: Fetch one expense by ID from the pinned Clockify workspace.

tools.name: clockify_expenses_delete
tools.description: Permanently delete one expense by ID from the pinned workspace. Run dry_run first, then retry with the returned confirm_token.

tools.name: clockify_expenses_create
tools.description: Create a workspace expense from amount, category, project, and date; defaults the user to the API-key owner. The amount is in MAJOR currency units (19.99 = $19.99), not cents.

amount.description: Amount in MAJOR currency units (19.99 = $19.99). Expense amounts are NOT cents, unlike invoice and rate fields.

categoryId.description: Category id (24-hex) or exact category name.

tools.name: clockify_expenses_update
tools.description: Update an expense by ID (full replace of amount, category, date, plus any optional fields supplied). The amount is in MAJOR currency units (19.99 = $19.99), not cents.

amount.description: Amount in MAJOR currency units (19.99 = $19.99). Expense amounts are NOT cents, unlike invoice and rate fields.

categoryId.description: Category id (24-hex) or exact category name.

tools.name: clockify_expenses_categories_list
tools.description: List workspace expense categories with bounded pagination controls.

tools.name: clockify_expenses_categories_create
tools.description: Create a new expense category. Use unit/priceInCents when you want fixed-price categories.

tools.name: clockify_expenses_categories_update
tools.description: Update an expense category name, unit pricing, or price behavior by ID.

tools.name: clockify_expenses_categories_delete
tools.description: Permanently delete an expense category by ID. Run dry_run first, then retry with the returned confirm_token.

tools.name: clockify_expenses_categories_archive
tools.description: Toggle the archived state on an expense category.

tools.name: clockify_webhooks_list
tools.description: List outbound webhook subscriptions in the workspace.

tools.name: clockify_webhooks_get
tools.description: Fetch a single webhook subscription by ID.

tools.name: clockify_webhooks_delivery_diagnose
tools.description: Inspect the latest delivery status and retry details for a webhook. Response bodies are always omitted for safety.

tools.name: clockify_webhooks_create
tools.description: Subscribe a URL to a Clockify event. URL must be HTTPS and is rejected pre-flight if it points at a loopback, private, link-local, CGNAT, or cloud-metadata host.

tools.name: clockify_webhooks_update
tools.description: Update a webhook subscription's name, URL, event, or trigger source.

tools.name: clockify_webhooks_delete
tools.description: Permanently delete a webhook subscription. Run dry_run first, then retry with the returned confirm_token.

tools.name: clockify_webhooks_events
tools.description: List every valid webhook event type you can subscribe to (static registry; no API call). Use one as `webhookEvent` in clockify_webhooks_create.

tools.name: clockify_custom_fields_list
tools.description: List custom field definitions in the workspace.

tools.name: clockify_custom_fields_create
tools.description: Create a custom field definition at the workspace level.

type.description: Clockify field type, e.g. TXT, NUMBER, DROPDOWN_SINGLE.

tools.name: clockify_custom_fields_update
tools.description: Update a workspace custom field definition and its allowed values.

tools.name: clockify_custom_fields_delete
tools.description: Permanently delete a workspace custom field definition. Run dry_run first, then retry with the returned confirm_token.

tools.name: clockify_project_custom_fields_list
tools.description: List custom field associations on a project.

tools.name: clockify_project_custom_fields_update
tools.description: Update a custom field association on a project (status and/or default value). Allowed values are defined on the workspace-level definition, not the project association.

tools.name: clockify_project_custom_fields_remove
tools.description: Detach one custom field association from a project by ID. Run dry_run first, then retry with the returned confirm_token.

tools.name: clockify_time_off_requests_list
tools.description: List time-off requests in the workspace with filters and pagination.

tools.name: clockify_time_off_requests_get
tools.description: Fetch one time-off request by ID from the pinned workspace.

tools.name: clockify_time_off_requests_submit
tools.description: Submit a time-off request against a policy.

policyId.description: Policy id (24-hex) or exact policy name.

start.description: Start date. DAYS-unit policies want a date-only start (yyyy-MM-dd); HOURS-unit policies want a full RFC3339 datetime (yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ssZ).

end.description: Range end (RFC3339). Required by HOURS-unit (date-range) policies; omit for DAYS-unit policies and pass `days`. Provide `end` OR `days`.

days.description: Number of days. Required by DAYS-unit policies; omit for HOURS-unit policies and pass `end`. Provide `end` OR `days`.

tools.name: clockify_time_off_requests_update_status
tools.description: Approve, reject, or change the status of a time-off request. Requires policyId — the status endpoint is policy-scoped.

policyId.description: Policy id (24-hex) or exact policy name.

tools.name: clockify_time_off_requests_delete
tools.description: Permanently delete one PENDING time-off request. Requires policyId — the delete endpoint is policy-scoped (the flat /time-off/requests/{id} route 404s). Only PENDING requests are deletable; terminal APPROVED/REJECTED requests have no delete path. Run dry_run first, then retry with the returned confirm_token.

policyId.description: Policy id (24-hex) or exact policy name.

tools.name: clockify_time_off_requests_create_for_user
tools.description: Submit a time-off request on behalf of another workspace user. Use clockify_request_time_off for your own request. The period shape is policy-unit dependent: a DAYS-unit policy wants start plus days, an HOURS-unit policy wants start plus end. Run dry_run first, then retry with the returned confirm_token.

policyId.description: Policy id (24-hex) or exact policy name.

userId.description: Workspace user id, exact name, email, or `me`.

start.description: Period start: YYYY-MM-DD for a DAYS-unit policy, RFC3339 for HOURS.

end.description: Period end (RFC3339); HOURS-unit policies need it.

days.description: Days requested; DAYS-unit policies need it.

tools.name: clockify_time_off_policies_list
tools.description: List time-off policies in the workspace with bounded pagination.

tools.name: clockify_time_off_policies_get
tools.description: Fetch one time-off policy by ID from the pinned workspace.

tools.name: clockify_time_off_policies_create
tools.description: Create a new time-off policy with optional approval and balance settings.

requiresApproval.description: Whether time-off requests under this policy need approval.

userIds.description: Apply to these users (sent as a CONTAINS filter).

userGroupIds.description: Apply to these user groups (sent as a CONTAINS filter).

tools.name: clockify_time_off_policies_update
tools.description: Update one time-off policy by ID. Reads the policy then replaces it (PUT semantics), preserving untouched fields and the user/group scope.

userIds.description: Replace the scope with these users.

userGroupIds.description: Replace the scope with these user groups.

tools.name: clockify_time_off_policies_archive
tools.description: Toggle the archived state of a time-off policy.

tools.name: clockify_time_off_balances_list
tools.description: List user balances for a time-off policy.

tools.name: clockify_time_off_balance_for_user
tools.description: Fetch a single user's time-off balance across policies.

tools.name: clockify_time_off_balances_update
tools.description: Replace the selected users' balance with `value` in the time-off policy's configured unit. Read the policy and current balances first when the unit is uncertain.

policyId.description: Policy id (24-hex) or exact policy name.

userIds.description: One or more workspace user ids, exact names, emails, or `me`.

value.description: Replacement balance value in the selected policy's configured unit; this is not a delta.

note.description: Required audit explanation for the adjustment.

tools.name: clockify_time_off_balance_assignments_list
tools.description: List one user's time-off balance assignments for a single policy. Returns the assignment id needed by the update and delete tools.

policyId.description: Policy id (24-hex) or exact policy name.

userId.description: Workspace user id, exact name, email, or `me`.

tools.name: clockify_time_off_balance_assignments_create
tools.description: Add `balance` to the selected users' balance for one policy, in the policy's configured unit. The amount is additive: if a user already has an assignment for the policy, the API adds to it and keeps the same assignment id; if not, the API creates one. Run dry_run first, then retry with the returned confirm_token.

policyId.description: Policy id (24-hex) or exact policy name.

userIds.description: One or more workspace user ids, exact names, emails, or `me`.

balance.description: Amount to add in the policy's configured unit; this is a delta, not a replacement value. A negative amount withdraws balance.

note.description: Audit explanation for the balance change.

tools.name: clockify_time_off_balance_assignments_update
tools.description: Apply `balanceChange` to one existing balance assignment. The change is a delta added to the current balance, not a replacement value; a negative value withdraws balance. Get the assignment id from clockify_time_off_balance_assignments_list. Run dry_run first, then retry with the returned confirm_token.

policyId.description: Policy id (24-hex) or exact policy name.

userId.description: Workspace user id, exact name, email, or `me`.

balanceChange.description: Delta applied to the current balance, in the policy's configured unit. A negative value withdraws balance.

note.description: Audit explanation for the balance change.

tools.name: clockify_time_off_balance_assignments_delete
tools.description: Permanently delete one balance assignment. The whole accrued balance for that user and policy is removed. The API requires a note and rejects an empty one. Run dry_run first, then retry with the returned confirm_token.

policyId.description: Policy id (24-hex) or exact policy name.

userId.description: Workspace user id, exact name, email, or `me`.

note.description: Required audit explanation for the deletion.

tools.name: clockify_scheduling_assignments_list
tools.description: List scheduling assignments in the workspace over a date range, with pagination and name filters. start/end are required — the endpoint 400s (code 3001) without them.

start.description: Range start, ISO-8601 datetime (yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ssZ). Required — the endpoint 400s (code 3001) without it.

end.description: Range end, ISO-8601 datetime (yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ssZ). Required — the endpoint 400s without it.

tools.name: clockify_scheduling_assignments_list_per_project
tools.description: Scheduling assignment totals grouped by project. start/end are required for both branches (each 400s without them). Pass a projectId for one project's totals (a dedicated GET endpoint); otherwise the all-projects search.

projectId.description: One project's totals. Uses the GET .../projects/totals/{projectId} endpoint (also requires start/end).

start.description: Range start, ISO-8601 datetime (yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ssZ). Required for both the single-project GET and the all-projects search.

end.description: Range end, ISO-8601 datetime (yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ssZ). Required for both the single-project GET and the all-projects search.

tools.name: clockify_scheduling_assignments_create
tools.description: Create a scheduling assignment. Defaults to draft (published:false) to avoid notifying other users.

tools.name: clockify_scheduling_assignments_update
tools.description: Edit a scheduling assignment's date range, hours, task, billable flag, or note by ID. This is a PATCH on the recurring-assignment route (the bare /assignments/{id} PUT 404s live), so start+end are required and seriesUpdateOption scopes the edit across a series. The route cannot reassign the user or project — recreate the assignment to move it.

start.description: New range start, ISO-8601 datetime (yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ssZ). Required.

end.description: New range end, ISO-8601 datetime (yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ssZ). Required.

seriesUpdateOption.description: Which occurrences of a recurring series to apply the edit to. Defaults to this assignment only.

userId.description: Not supported by this route — reassigning the user is rejected. Recreate the assignment to move it.

projectId.description: Not supported by this route — reassigning the project is rejected. Recreate the assignment to move it.

tools.name: clockify_scheduling_assignments_delete
tools.description: Permanently delete a scheduling assignment. Hits the recurring-assignment route (DELETE /scheduling/assignments/recurring/{id}; the bare /assignments/{id} DELETE 404s live); seriesUpdateOption scopes the deletion across a recurring series. Run dry_run first, then retry with the returned confirm_token.

seriesUpdateOption.description: Which occurrences of a recurring series to delete. Defaults to this assignment only.

tools.name: clockify_scheduling_copy

instructions: This Clockify MCP operates on one workspace pinned for the current caller. The local stdio server resolves it from CLOCKIFY_WORKSPACE_ID; remote deployments resolve it from the authenticated principal. Use clockify_status first to confirm credentials, workspace, and running timer state. On first run, get the clockify-getting-started prompt and read the clockify://guide/which-tool resource. Prefer workflow tools before low-level domain tools. Use IDs returned by previous structured receipts rather than re-resolving names. For every tool whose confirmation metadata is preview_token—business writes, external side effects, privileged writes, and destructive writes—run dry_run first and reuse the returned confirm_token. Inspect ids, changed, warnings, next, stable error codes, and recovery hints. If a feature is unavailable on the workspace plan, report the recovery hint and continue.
